messages:
alex: quick heads-up — we saw sporadic 20–35% tail token-latency spikes on a prod shard during a KV-cache-heavy workload. spikes align with kernel scheduling windows in the nsys timeline. full nsys traces are huge and add noise. need a safe low-impact profiling plan we can run in prod without blowing up tail latency.

sana: agreed. full traces in prod are risky. thoughts: periodic low-sample nsys runs + trigger-based full capture on anomalies? keep sampling budget under 2% of requests.

kevin: +1. practical guardrails: 1) sample at request-level (1 in N requests) for low overhead. 2) if sampled request shows >X ms stalled GPU time or unexpected kernel switch, enqueue a high-res capture for that PID for T seconds. 3) cap concurrent high-res captures to 1 per host.

marta: can we get concrete cmds? e.g., lightweight sampling with nsys CLI and then a conditional nvprof/torch-trace? also what's the overhead baseline?

kevin: baseline numbers from staging: lightweight nsys capture with --capture-range=none + events-only ~0.4% CPU/GPU overhead at 1/100 sampling. full timeline (kernel timestamps + CUPTI) ~8–12% overhead per host while active. so we must restrict full timeline to short windows and ensure circuit-breaker.

alex: nice. here is a sketch of the automation logic I had in mind:

```
# pseudocode
if random() % 100 == 0:  # 1% sample
  run nsys --capture-range=nvtx --output=light.%s
  analyze summary -> if stalled_kernel_time > 100ms:
    if concurrent_full_captures < 1 and host_load < 0.6:
      kick full nsys timeline for 5s to full.%s
```

kevin: additions: - prefer prefix/KV-cache probes rather than sampling every request if latency distribution is prefix-heavy. - include a time-decay counter so we don't repeatedly full-capture the same session.

marta: also watch kernel selection churn: some of the spikes correspond to kernel fallback (fp16->fp32 path) when quantized kernels hit a corner case. we should tag samples with model+quantization config so we can correlate.

perf-bot: automated note — recent lightweight-sampling job (2026-02-18 08:12 UTC) reported 0.6% overhead, 12 samples, 2 suspected blocked kernels. artifacts at s3://redwood-inference/profiler/1978880123/light/

alex: good to have. decision checklist proposal: 1) default sample rate 1% per route, 2) compute route-level sampling budget so hot routes get lower rate, 3) full-capture trigger: stalled GPU kernel >150ms or >3 blocked kernels in 10s, 4) host-level cap 1 concurrent full-capture, 5) TTL per-session 5s, 6) store metadata (route, model, quant, kv-hit-rate).

sana: +1 with one change: lower the stalled threshold to 100ms for small models (<1B) and 200ms for large models — because baseline latencies differ. also add an emergency off switch for SLO-impacted windows.

kevin: I can implement the controller and the probe. implementation notes: - use eBPF probe for prefix/KV-hit detection (cheap) - attach CUPTI counters only during sampled runs - tracer should emit compact summary (hot kernel names, durations) to our trace index, not raw big files unless full-capture.

marta: routing note: when full-capture happens and we detect fallback kernel name patterns (e.g., conv_gemm_fp32_fallback), schedule a low-priority job to run a deterministic microbenchmark on the suspect kernel with matching sequence lengths and batch sizes. helps reproduce and tune kernel selection rules.

alex: action items: kevin implement controller + cap, marta create kernel-name heuristics and microbench harness, sana add per-route sampling budget to console UI, I'll draft the runbook and error thresholds. target: small rollout to one dedicated shard by next Tues.

kevin: i'll open a PR with the controller + config. I'll include an example nsys/light capture command: `nsys profile --output=light.%s --trace=gpu,cuda_runtime --sample=cpu` for the lightweight captures and `nsys profile --output=full.%s --trace=cuda,cudnn,osrt --capture-range=timerange --timerange=start:stop` for full timeline (only under trigger).

marta: sounds good. also remind infra to add an alert when concurrent_full_captures > 0.

alex: thanks — keeping this conservative. we'll reconvene after kevin's PR and one successful shard run. :thumbsup:
